messages:
Priya: Quick poll — we need a name for the new office 'build-your-own bowl' station. Vote by reacting to this message with the emoji. Options:
:bowl_with_spoon: Cache & Quinoa
:rocket: Model Mix
:seedling: Garden Stack
:corn: Kernel Bowl
Drop a one-line comment if you have a tie-breaker or extra idea. I'll tally in 1 hour. :slightly_smiling_face:

Mateo: :bowl_with_spoon: Cache & Quinoa from me. Also please keep a falafel option available?

Alex: :rocket: Model Mix — sounds hacker-y, love it :smile:

Irene: :seedling: Garden Stack — vegetarian here, please label GF/vegan options :raised_hands:

Ken: :corn: Kernel Bowl gets my vote. Big fan of puns :popcorn:

Lina: :bowl_with_spoon: (voted)

SnackBot: Poll started (ID: 924). Reminder will post in 30 minutes.

Mateo: Also can we add small allergy labels on the station? Peanut, sesame, soy etc.

Alex: +1 to allergy labels :thumbsup:

Priya: Noted on labels. Quick mid-tally: Cache & Quinoa 2, Model Mix 1, Garden Stack 1, Kernel Bowl 1. Keep reacting!

Priya: Final tally (closing poll): Cache & Quinoa 3, Model Mix 2, Garden Stack 2, Kernel Bowl 1. Winner: Cache & Quinoa — I'll get a sign made and share the design tomorrow. Thanks y'all :tada:
